newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Ciba SC sees strong oper profit increase.
newsitem.headline: Ciba SC sees strong oper profit increase.

text.p: Ciba Specialty Chemicals Inc said on Wednesday it expected a strong improvement in its operating profit before restructuring expenses.
It also repeated its expectations for restructuring charges and one-time expenses related to its spinoff from Novartis AG of between 250 million and 300 million Swiss francs in 1997.

"Barring unforeseen setbacks, including unfavourable currency developments or changes in economic conditions, Ciba Specialty Chemicals expects a strong improvement in this year's operating profit before restructuring expenses," the company said in its first quarter statement.
Ciba Specialty Chemicals had a 1996 operating profit, before extraordinaries, of 501 million Swiss francs.
Restructuring and other charges taken in 1996 related to its spinoff from Novartis totalled 1.077 billion francs.
